Customer Reference

Build and leverage customer success stories that prove value and influence buyer decisions.

Know Learn Do
Know

What is Customer Reference?

Understand what you own, what great looks like, and how to measure it.

⚠️ Needs PMM Validation
Role Card

What this area is

Customer Reference is the practice of capturing, packaging, and deploying customer success stories. It transforms customer experiences into powerful proof points that validate SAP's value and influence buyer decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit reference customers
  • Develop case studies and success stories
  • Manage reference program operations
  • Support sales with reference connections
  • Protect and nurture reference relationships

Key deliverables

  • Case studies and success stories
  • Reference customer database
  • Video testimonials
  • Reference request process
  • Reference health dashboard
Playbook
1

Reference identification

Work with customer success to identify referenceable customers. Define criteria and prioritization.

2

Story development

Conduct interviews, gather data, and craft compelling narratives that highlight outcomes.

3

Asset creation

Produce case studies, videos, quotes, and other reference assets in multiple formats.

4

Program operations

Manage reference requests, track usage, and protect customers from over-use.

5

Relationship nurturing

Keep references engaged through recognition, access, and value exchange.

Success Metrics
Reference Coverage
% of products/industries with active references
Reference Utilization
% of deals using customer references
Reference Health
NPS/satisfaction of reference customers
Story Impact
Influence of references on deal outcomes
